title: Uniqueness of the equilibrium state in the dynamics of holomorphic correspondences
summary: This paper concerns the study of the existence of a unique equilibrium state for a Hölder continuous function under the dynamics of a holomorphic correspondence defined on the Riemann sphere. We mainly work with the correspondence restricted on the support of the Dinh-Sibony measure and identify topologically interesting correspondences, namely distance expanding ones. Further, we consider Hölder continuous potentials defined on the support of the Dinh-Sibony measure, for which we prove the uniqueness of equilibrium state. Along the way, we also prove some interesting topological results…
